thread:
Alex: Quick sanity check — final SLA matrix for GA. Are we green on latency targets, uptime, incident response, docs and the runbook handoff?
Maya: Almost. SLOs drafted, monitoring hooks mostly in, but we need clear RTO/RPO language for burst autoscale and canary rollback.
Sam: On runtime numbers: for our hosted small-model profile p99 ~ 180-220ms under normal load; for large models p99 sits around 700-900ms. Suggest SLA tiers rather than one-size-fits-all.
Alex: Agreed. Draft tiers below — please comment: 
```
Gold: p99 <= 250ms (small models), 99.9% uptime, 2h on-call acknowledgement, 8h mitigation window
Silver: p99 <= 500ms, 99.5% uptime, 4h ack, 24h mitigation window
Bronze: p99 <= 1s, 99.0% uptime, next-business-day acknowledgement, community support
```
Priya: Docs note — we need to distinguish "acknowledgement" vs "initial triage" in customer-facing SLA language. Ops/legal prefer "acknowledgement" for contract clarity.
Jordan: Support coverage mapping: Gold -> 24/7 Premium + phone escalation, Silver -> business-hours + prioritized email, Bronze -> email + public docs. Sales asked for an explicit onboarding SLA for Gold pilot customers.
Maya: Monitoring requirements: per-tenant token-level telemetry, synthetic probes for each region, and a regression detector on quality metrics (per-prompt evals). Add to runbook: svc_degraded_alert -> runbook step 1..n.
SRE-bot: new alert template created: `svc_degraded_alert` (owners: #eng-oncall, #product).
Sam: Rollout plan suggestion: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h windows, automated rollback to Silver variant if error rate exceeds threshold. Implement feature-flag + traffic-split. Example rollout policy: 
```
canary: target=5%, window=2h, evaluate=[error_rate, p99_latency]
step2: target=25%, window=24h
final: 100% with health-check gating
fallback: route -> silver-variant if error_rate > 0.5% for 10m
```
Alex: Pricing/Commercial: FinOps to run model of committed capacity discounts (monthly commit tiers) and burst pricing. Sales wants a locked pilot price for first 6 weeks. Need ACV and overage rules in docs.
Priya: I'll produce a "SLA summary" one-pager and a Runbook index page (links to playbooks, contact matrix, legal text). Need exact SLA phrasings by EOD Wed.
Jordan: Support readiness checklist — staff ramp schedule, rotation for premium support, runbook drills scheduled next Tue.
Maya: Monitoring checklist (short):
- synthetic probes in each target region
- per-tenant latency/error dashboards
- automated alert -> pager -> incident channel mapping
- periodic smoke tests post-deploy
Sam: Engineering action items:
- implement traffic-split + fallback policy (PR opened)
- expose per-tenant metrics to console (ETA 3 days)
- add rollback automation to control plane
Alex: Action owner recap:
- Sam: rollout + fallback automation (due +3d)
- Maya: alerting + synthetic probes (due +4d)
- Priya: SLA page + runbook index (due +2d)
- Jordan: support ramp schedule + staffing (due +5d)
- Alex: finalize SLA contract language with Legal & FinOps (due +6d)
Alex: If we hit these, we can greenlight GA gate review next Friday. Any blockers? :eyes:
Maya: One blocker — we need confirmation from infra on reserved capacity limits for Gold pilot. Pinged infra.
Sam: FYI: there may be a perf variance on night-batch workloads; will add a note to the SLA appendix.
Priya: Will mock up the customer-facing SLA page and share in #product-docs for review today.
Jordan: I'll lineup 2x on-call people for the first 2 weeks post-GA for premium customers.
Alex: Cool — thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow after infra reply. :thumbsup:
